about: Registry of promotion items (Constitution §3B, §6). One item per post or PR, added when it goes live. tools/metrics.mjs snapshots each item into history/metrics/channels.csv; tools/evidence.mjs records the owner's screenshots.

fields.url: public URL of the post or PR
fields.promo: path of the promotion package, e.g. history/promo/earnstar_1/O-003-hn/
fields.evidence: [{file, bytes, sha256, added_utc}]: owner screenshots, stored privately in archive/promo/ (tools/evidence.mjs)
fields.owner_reported: [{read_utc, score, comments, source}]: metrics read from owner screenshots when the API is unavailable (e.g., Reddit)
